messages:
Oliver: Heads up — the Console is showing a vague 'route validation failed' modal when teams bump the routing schema to v2. No line-level pointer so it's impossible to know which field to change.
Maria: Saw that in the wild today. It just says 'invalid payload' and you have to guess whether it's a header matcher, an override, or a regex.
Tasha: can you paste a small repro yaml?
Oliver: ```yaml
routes:
  - id: feature-toggle
    match:
      path: /api/.*
      headers:
        - name: x-variant
          value: (blue|green)
    overrides:
      priority: 10
``` 
Maria: Thanks. The root cause: schema v2 renamed `overrides.priority` -> `overrides.weight` and our validator returns a generic error at the object level instead of a specific path. So Console shows a modal with the top-level error only.
Samir: Proposal: add a preflight step in the Console authoring flow that diffs the config against the selected schema version and shows per-field warnings + suggested fixes. Also a toggle for "strict lint" vs "warn-only".
Tasha: I agree, but default should be permissive (warn) for non-breaking UX. Autofix suggestions can be opt-in. :thumbsup:
Oliver: Also want the error pointer to map to YAML line numbers so the editor can highlight the exact lines. Right now AJV gives JSONPaths; we need jsonpath->line mapping.
Samir: There are known utilities to map JSON pointer to YAML line ranges. We can wrap that into our schema validator plugin.
Maria: For rollout: Console should show a small banner when saving configs that would be auto-updated by a migration, and a one-click "apply migration" that creates a suggested patch in the editor with changelog.
ConsoleQA: added an e2e that reproduces the modal -> user confusion in PR #3456, failing on CI.
Oliver: Nice — can we also surface why it's a warning vs error (e.g., deprecation vs required rename)?
Tasha: I have a tiny util that annotates AJV errors with deprecation metadata (from our model catalog). I'll drop it in eng-platform-utils.
Samir: Implementation notes: 1) extend lint pipeline to emit categorized diagnostics (error/warn/info), 2) Console preflight shows diagnostics inline with recommended code action, 3) enable autofix generator that emits a patch (git-style hunk) and a one-line rationale.
Maria: I'll draft a short design doc outlining UX flows and the api for the lint service. Aim to include example diffs and CI gating rules.
LintBot: rule: route-overrides-deprecation severity=warning affected=overrides.priority details="rename to overrides.weight"
Oliver: Great. Action items: Samir to prototype JSONPath->line mapping; Tasha to publish util; Maria to draft doc; ConsoleQA to keep the failing e2e. Sync tomorrow 10am? :calendar:
Samir: SGTM.
Tasha: I'll attach the util and a small test fixture before EOD.
Maria: Thanks all — this should cut down on the number of "which field" support tickets.
ConsoleQA: noted, monitoring ticket volume for related errors.
__notes: This thread captures a short eng-platform discussion about schema migration UX, inline linting, YAML line mapping, and adding preflight autofix suggestions in the Console. Messages are in chronological order and include a small YAML snippet and a lint bot annotation.
